title: Build a scroll-driven walkthrough website for a building
summary: An architect-minded builder had Claude Code make a website where scrolling moves an AI-generated camera from the sea, across a terrace and into a building.
agent_role: Claude Code wrote the website and tied the AI-generated walkthrough footage to the page scroll. The human supplied the concept and footage direction.
outcome: Author shows a working site in a demo video where scrolling controls the camera.
what_they_did: The poster used Claude Code to build a website for an architecture project. They had AI-generated walkthrough footage that moves from the sea, over a terrace and into the building. Claude Code linked that footage to the page so scrolling moves the camera.
how_it_went: The author shares a video of the finished site, with the camera moving as the visitor scrolls.
prompt: Build a single-page website for [project or building name]. I have a walkthrough video at [video file path] that moves from [starting view] to [ending view]. Tie the video's playback to page scrolling, so scrolling down moves the camera forward and scrolling up moves it back. Add short text panels at [key moments]. Keep it smooth on phones and desktops. Show me the plan first, then build it and let me review it locally before anything is published.

curation.rationale: A genuine Claude Code build with a demo video and an unusual scroll-controlled walkthrough idea, but the post gives almost no detail on steps or tools.
